skill.name: Pierce
skill.description: Throw a fast moving spear that passes through enemies it kills.

skill.name: Piercing Arrow
skill.description: Varus readies and then fires a powerful shot that gains extra range and damage the longer he spends preparing to fire.

skill.name: Hail of Arrows
skill.description: Varus fires a hail of arrows that deal physical damage and desecrate the ground. Desecrated ground slows enemies' Move Speed and reduces their self healing and regeneration.

skill.name: Jaws of the Beast
skill.description: Warwick lunges forward and bites his target, dealing damage based on their maximum health and healing for damage dealt.
